remarks: Opportunity Knocks! Looking for a great place to live or a wonderful investment? This home is close to "Everything Stamford" such as beaches, trains, highway, downtown etc. This desirable end unit at the quietest part of the complex offers a reserved parking space directly in front of unit along with ample visitor parking close by. A unique feature for this unit is the "in unit" laundry! Most other units in the complex have only shared laundry in basement. There is storage in the basement. Bring your imagination and make this gem sparkle. You'll end up with perhaps the best townhome in the Hamilton Green complex!
